construction: Two source stages combine a 6636 tile, two small spacers/caps and three 44728 brackets into a six-piece rail.
interfaces: The brackets expose a common perpendicular stud face. Their parent door supplies the remaining panel and hinge stack; the rail alone is not a complete opening door.
lesson: A thin visible trim rail can also carry a repeated sideways stud field behind it.
parent_context: subModel-34.ldr declares this child at [0,-88,0], in source step 7. The complete car's corresponding door is added in main source step 43. Its saved door is a separate callout, not a declared child of main.ldr.
reuse_notes: Transfer the repeated-bracket pattern to door trim or another narrow fascia. Keep the original spacing until actual sockets on the new panel have been inspected, then check the combined assembly.
